cards.title: 10.1 German, Italian and Japanese Aggression in the
body: The Treaty of Versailles limited Germany’s military power and crippled its economy through heavy reparations.
When Hitler came to power, he denounced the Treaty and vowed to cancel it.

cards.title: Aggression and the road to war
body: Japan invaded Manchuria (1931); Italy invaded Ethiopia (1935); Germany re-militarised the Rhineland (1936), united with Austria (**Anschluss, March 1938**) and took the Sudetenland

cards.title: 10.2 The Courses of WWII
body: On September 28, 1939, Germany and Soviet Union officially divided Poland between them.
September 3, 1939, war did not begin automatically.

cards.title: Course of the war
